dict.string: Jarvis needs microphone access to hear voice commands.
Jarvis may use the camera for vision features.
Jarvis needs screen recording access to look at your screen when you ask.
Jarvis uses AppleScript to control Apple apps (Notes, Music, Messages, etc).
Jarvis can search your Contacts when asked.
Jarvis may search your Calendar when asked.
Jarvis may set Reminders when asked.
Jarvis may run shell commands when asked.
